name: Diabolical Plans
summary: Recovered from a demon in eastern Ashenvale, this parchment outlines an imminent demonic assault against Splintertree Post. Shockingly composed in the Orcish tongue, the orders reveal that the infamous dreadlords Diathorus and Gorgannon are coordinating forces against the Horde's forest outpost.

sections.title: A Written Threat
sections.body: While demons typically rely on raw carnage and fel dominance, this fallen parchment reveals deliberate strategy. The orders are penned in Orcish—a chilling testament to how intimately the Burning Legion understands its former thralls. The text explicitly outlines preparations for an organized strike on Splintertree Post to the northwest, proving the local fiends are acting under unified, calculating commanders.

sections.title: Shadows of the Dreadlords
sections.body: The recovered parchment specifically names Diathorus the Seeker and Gorgannon, two notorious dreadlords wielding dominion over the demonic forces lurking among the ruins and barrows of eastern Ashenvale. Rather than mindless remnants from the Third War, these nathrezim are actively organizing surviving satyrs, felguards, and cultists to push the Horde entirely out of the woods.

sections.title: A Call to Arms at Splintertree
sections.body: Splintertree Post serves as the Horde's vital bastion in central Ashenvale, constantly besieged by enraged night elves and woodland beasts. Word of an impending demonic offensive threatens to crush the outpost between two fronts. Delivering the plans into the hands of Valusha alerts the garrison to the impending strike, galvanizing the defenders to mount a preemptive counterattack before the dreadlords can march.

faq.answer: They are strategic invasion orders dropped by a demon in Ashenvale. The parchment describes military preparations for a targeted demonic assault aimed at destroying the Horde encampment at Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why are the demon plans written in Orcish?
aliases: who wrote the plans in orcish
faq.answer: The Burning Legion spent generations manipulating and enslaving the orcs through the blood curse. The dreadlords are master infiltrators who understand Orcish fluently, enabling them to draft orders that communicate precise targets or mock their intended prey.

aliases: who are the dreadlords in ashenvale
faq.answer: Diathorus the Seeker and Gorgannon are two dreadlords directing the remaining demonic forces in eastern Ashenvale. From tainted sanctuaries like the Fire Scar Shrine and Laughing Sister barrows, they coordinate remnants of the Legion to terrorize mortal settlements.

aliases: who do i turn diabolical plans in to
faq.answer: Take the parchment to Valusha, an orc officer stationed at Splintertree Post to the northwest. She organizes the garrison's defense against local threats and will prepare a counter-strike against the dreadlords.

faq.q: Why is the Legion targeting Splintertree Post?
aliases: what do the demons want with splintertree
faq.answer: Splintertree Post is the primary Horde outpost securing the forest interior. Eliminating it would shatter the Horde presence in central Ashenvale, leaving the region fractured and defenseless against dreadlord domination.

faq.q: What happens after giving the plans to Valusha?
aliases: what is the follow up quest
faq.answer: Enraged that the dreadlords dare plot against the outpost, Valusha refuses to cower behind palisades. She rallies the garrison to strike first, sending heroes directly into demon territory to eliminate Diathorus and Gorgannon.

angles.text: Splintertree Post already faces intense pressure from the Sentinel army. Discovering that dreadlords are orchestrating a second front makes securing the post's borders an urgent priority.
Finding demonic plans written in the orc mother tongue is a bitter reminder of the Legion's historical corruption and lingering shadow over the orcish people.
The nathrezim remain master tacticians of fel sorcery; deciphering their battlefield orders gives insight into the command hierarchy of rogue demons in Kalimdor.
